messages.subject: User study on data visualization using ggplot2
parts:
Hello!

Do you have experiences in creating data visualizations using R ggplot2?

We are researchers looking for participants (both novice and experienced visualization users of ggplot2) to join in a paid online user study about visualization using R. The study will take approximately 1.5 hours in Zoom, and you'll get a $50 amazon gift card as an appreciation for your time. The study will be taken in June.

If you are interested, please fill out the following survey:
* https://forms.gle/hcKhuyNB9LCU3HrH9 

Let us know by email if you have any questions about the study!

Thanks!
Chenglong Wang & Yu Feng
